title: Particle
description: x-particle fills its host with small dots that float upward continuously, each at a random size, position and speed. Pressing the host gives press feedback (x-particle--pressed).

count.description: How many dots float in the host.

color.description: Dot colour, as any CSS colour (`--x-particle-color`). Empty uses the theme's primary colour.

_metadata.derivedFrom: effects.js particle() — every property here is one the behavior reads
